5.name: holt briefs them on break-in entry
5.description: Holt explains that investigators determined the workshop was entered through the east-facing window.
evidence: Our people examined the workshop this morning. The entry point was the east-facing WINDOW.

5.name: holt reveals latch was old damage
5.description: Holt states the window latch had been broken from age and neglect rather than by a recent forced entry, implying the thief exploited that weakness.
evidence: The latch was broken -- not forced recently, broken from age and neglect. The thief knew this or discovered it on approach.

5.name: felix denies knowing broken latch
5.description: Felix says he did not know the workshop window latch was broken.
evidence:
FELIX
I did not know the latch was broken.

5.name: holt identifies satchel as sable's
5.description: Holt announces that the satchel found near Felix's desk belongs to Sable.
evidence: The satchel found near your desk, Mr. Adler. It belongs to Miss Cross.

5.name: holt clears sable with alibi
5.description: Holt says independent witnesses place Sable at the market all morning, establishing an unambiguous alibi and clearing her of suspicion.
evidence: We have confirmed your whereabouts independently.
Three separate stall-keepers in the market square placed you there from before first bell until after the midday toll.
You were at the market all morning. That is an unambiguous alibi. Miss Cross is cleared of any suspicion.
5.time_hint: from before first bell until after the midday toll; all morning

5.name: sable expresses relief
5.description: Sable exhales and thanks Holt after being cleared.

5.name: holt says someone framed sable
5.description: Holt warns that someone deliberately tried to implicate Sable using the satchel and is pursuing both the map and suspicion toward Felix's apprentice.
evidence: Do not thank me yet. Someone wanted you implicated.
That means they knew about the satchel or found it and used it.
The question is who benefits from the map and from casting doubt on your apprentice.

5.name: felix names wren as suspect
5.description: Felix identifies Wren as the likely person behind the theft and framing.

5.name: holt cautions lack of proof
5.description: Holt says there is not yet proof against Wren and warns Felix and Sable to be careful.
evidence: We do not have proof. Not yet. But I want both of you to be careful.
